AnimatedTitle.description: A large title with an optional subtitle and an animated underline. Good for intros and transitions.

ComparisonCard.description: A card displaying a side-by-side comparison with pros and cons. Good for evaluating options.

BulletList.description: A bulleted or numbered list with staggered reveal animation.

StepFlow.description: A horizontal step-by-step flow diagram with an animated connector line.

StatCallout.description: A large statistic callout with an animated counting number.

ArchitectureDiagram.description: Renders an architecture diagram with servers, databases, and load balancers connected by animated data streams and arrows. Specify nodes and connections.

SplitScreen.description: A layout scene showing a title, bullet points, code snippets, and optional media on the right side. Great for explaining technical concepts.

TypewriterText.description: Animated typewriter effect with a blinking cursor. Reveals one or more lines of text character by character. Great for code reveals or dramatic text.

TimelineFlow.description: An animated vertical or horizontal timeline with events appearing in staggered sequence. Use for history, roadmaps, or step-by-step processes.

QuoteCard.description: A full-screen animated pull quote with an optional highlight sweep on key words and author attribution. Great for testimonials and impactful statements.

CodeBlock.description: A macOS-style code window with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and optional line-by-line reveal animation. Ideal for showing code examples.

TwoColumnLayout.description: A two-column comparison layout with an animated center divider. Each column has a heading and bullet points that slide in from opposite sides.

BarChart.description: An animated bar chart with vertical or horizontal layout. Bars grow in with spring physics and values count up from 0. Use for data comparisons.

PacketFlow.description: An animated network topology where data packets travel along edges between nodes. Nodes are positioned by x/y percentage coordinates. Ideal for showing network protocols, request routing, TCP handshakes, and distributed system data flows.

HttpExchange.description: A side-by-side HTTP request and response viewer with line-by-line animated reveal. Shows method, path, headers, and body for both request and response. Great for explaining APIs, REST calls, and HTTP protocol details.
